name: in.enhanciar/enhanciar
title: Enhanciar — company brain
description: Ask your company brain from any MCP client. Cited answers from Slack, Gmail, Notion, Drive, GitHub.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer dh_<api-key>. Create a key in the Enhanciar app (Settings → API keys). Paid plans; bring your own AI key.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.about: Enhanciar is a company brain for every team. It reads your Slack, Gmail, Google Drive, Notion, Jira, Linear, GitHub, Zendesk and Postgres, answers any question with a link to every source, then drafts the follow-up (reply, ticket, doc, Slack post or calendar event) and waits for a person to approve it. From an MCP client you can ask cited questions, search and read the wiki, run impact analysis on code, and propose actions into the same approval queue your team sees in the app.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question; returns a synthesised answer with citations to code, Slack, docs.

tools.name: search_wiki
tools.description: Search the team's generated wiki pages.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read the full markdown of one wiki page.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List every wiki page the caller can see.

tools.name: get_graph
tools.description: Entity/community graph manifest for the workspace.

tools.name: impact
tools.description: Blast radius of changing a file, function or module.

tools.name: get_process_map
tools.description: How a process actually runs across code, people and tools.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: Reusable skills distilled from the codebase.

tools.name: propose_action
tools.description: Draft a Jira/Linear/Slack/calendar action for human approval.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: Paid. Solo $24/mo, Team $100/mo, Enterprise custom. Bring your own AI key (Gemini, OpenAI or Anthropic).
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.auth: Authorization: Bearer dh_<key> — keys minted in the Enhanciar app (Settings → API keys).
